parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests`) and verify different behavioural properties: one asserts that `isPlaying` is false after a stop, while the other asserts that play-after-stop succeeds idempotently. The structural similarity is a natural consequence of both tests exercising the same stop/play boundary, not an indication of unintentional duplication. Merging or extracting them would obscure the distinct intent of each test class.
